projects.title: Relax, Baton...
projects.description:
The well-known beverage company, Relax, enlisted our creative abilities to craft attention-grabbing billboard slogans designed to make travelers pause and ponder.

Infused with a touch of humor, we artfully crafted messages that subtly promoted the importance of slowing down in traffic.

We brainstormed various slogans, including "Relax, Baton: Put down that phone”, "Relax, Lutw: There's no rush," "Relax, Hana: for you is waiting Nana" and more. All those slogans rhymed in Albanian.

A wide array of slogans immediately went viral on social networks after their publication, receiving thousands…
